integrity: Proof and full finite executable checker supplied; no finite search is presented as an all-size proof; self-review only and no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One propositional variable, Boolean connectives and non-contingency only, on fixed finite irreflexive complete Kripke frames. The primary motivating 2026 preprint was compared from public abstract/metadata, not from inaccessible full text. The finite checker establishes only sizes 1 through 9; the symbolic proof establishes all sizes. Potential indexing under alternative knowing-whether nomenclature is a residual novelty risk.
title: A sharp depth-two collapse of one-variable non-contingency logic on irreflexive cliques
